title: Agent Session Annotated Event
description: A finished agent session was rolled up by the enricher service into one summary (event count, tool-call count, working directory, short paragraph). Annotates the agent.session.ended event named by data.target_event_id (also this event's causationid); the envelope correlationid is the session's correlation id. Sibling of conversation.turn.annotated. Replaces the retired bare 'bloodbank.evt.report.session.completed' topic (33GOD-95). See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

session_id.description: Session correlation id: the correlationid shared by every event of the session (the key of Candystore's /sessions/{id}).

cwd.description: Working directory of the session, taken from its earliest event that names one; null when none does.

summary.description: Short paragraph describing what the session achieved (gateway model) or a heuristic one-liner.

event_count.description: Number of events Candystore held for the session when it was rolled up.

tool_call_count.description: Number of those events that were tool calls.

summary_source.description: How the summary was produced: gateway = LLM paragraph; heuristic = no gateway key configured, counted summary; gateway_failed = gateway call errored, fallback text.

target_event_id.description: id of the agent.session.ended event that caused this annotation (also this event's causationid).
